change_summary: The journal's editors issued an expression of concern about the paper. They say concerns have been raised about some of the data and that the matter is being looked into. The notice doesn't say which data, so it's unclear whether the forced-swim result in Figure 3 or the bacterial counts in Figure 4 are involved.
evaluation: Your Discussion cites Lopez and Chen [8] as showing reduced activity in recipient mice, and says your own proposal builds on this finding. The paper's abstract reports that result from a forced-swim test (Figure 3). The editors have been made aware of concerns regarding some of the data reported in the article, and the notice does not say which data. It is therefore uncertain whether the result you rely on is involved. Because your Discussion and proposal lean on this finding, the impact is moderate.
recommendation: Hedge the Discussion sentence that cites Lopez and Chen [8] and avoid building new work on it, because the editors say they have been made aware of concerns regarding some of the data reported in the article and the notice does not say which data. Keep tracking, since the matter is being looked into.
